The Laredo Police Department is asking the public for help solving the unsolved murder of James “Jimmy” Ellis, a case that dates back to 2014, according to KGNS.

The killing happened near 200 Cortez in Laredo, according to KGNS. No arrests have been made, and the investigation remains active, with detectives following new leads and tips, including anonymous ones.

Detectives have identified a person of interest seen wearing a green shirt while leaving the area of Ellis' residence, according to KGNS. Police are asking people to review previously released photographs and video related to the case.

Anyone with information is asked to contact the Laredo Police Department at 956-795-2800 or Laredo Crime Stoppers at 727-TIPS. Tips can be made anonymously, according to KGNS.

The Laredo Morning Times also reported on the renewed public appeal for help solving Ellis' murder.

Sources: KGNS; Laredo Morning Times.
